name: chat-menu
title: Chat Menu
description: A menu with the chat's density: one column of tight rows, a blue ✓ and a number shortcut sharing the right slot, submenus that open on hover or →.

meta.whenToUse: Picking a model, an effort level or a scope from a chat's composer or header.
meta.whenNotToUse: A general actions menu (DropdownMenu), a searchable list (Combobox), or a long setting form (Select).
